Template.name: copy-block
Template.doc: a heading and the prose or list under it (icon heading + a 3px-gap slot)
Template.use: with copy-text · prose-list; not section when the region needs the standard gap above it

Template.name: copy-text
Template.doc: one paragraph of body prose (a single Text at the block's measure)
Template.use: with copy-block · section*; not three of these in a row is a page with no shape - the third one is a card

Template.name: copy-panel
Template.doc: a heading and its prose set apart on a tint (icon heading + slot on F5F6F8)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols2-top; not one per column - two tinted panels side by side read as borderless cards

Template.name: equation-band
Template.doc: a formula and the terms that feed it (tinted band, label + formula + slot)
Template.use: with page; not ratio-band when the point is the denominator

Template.name: event-detail
Template.doc: one dated event: when it runs, how long, by what method, and what it cites (icon head + count + period + duration/method + body + reference)
Template.use: with cols2 · section*; not stage when only the timing matters - this one carries the method and the citation

Template.name: copy-rail
Template.doc: a subject in a narrow rail beside its explanation (18px icon + 132px rail + body slot)
Template.use: with page; not index-rail when the rail indexes the page rather than naming a subject

Template.name: stage-detail
Template.doc: a numbered stage opening a block of prose (an 18px accent numeral + head + slot)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols2-top; not step-row when the stage fits one line

Template.name: stage-cell
Template.doc: one numbered stage of a strip laid across the block (a small accent number + head + slot at cellW)
Template.use: with stage-strip; not stage-detail when the stages stack rather than run across

Template.name: stage-strip
Template.doc: stages laid across the block (HStack, start, gap 14)
Template.use: with stage-cell · flow-step · num-step; not cols3 when the three are not a sequence

Template.name: ratio-band
Template.doc: a ratio with its denominator exposed (head + numerator over a rule over denominator + suffix)
Template.use: with section*; not stat-cell when the figure needs no denominator

Template.name: branch-detail
Template.doc: a condition and the branch it opens (a labelW column + accent arrow + slot)
Template.use: with section*; not choice-card when the branches are alternatives to weigh

Template.name: section-compact
Template.doc: a heading whose body is flat prose (icon heading + a 5px-gap slot)
Template.use: with copy-text; not copy-block when the body is a list

Template.name: prose-list
Template.doc: the container every list row sits in (a VStack that owns the row gap)
Template.use: with dot-row · num-row · prose-item; not never set the gap on a wrapper of your own

Template.name: prose-item
Template.doc: a list row whose mark the page supplies - a number, a letter, a code (a right-aligned 20px mark column)
Template.use: with prose-list; not a bullet is not a mark; the unordered list is dot-row

Template.name: dot-row
Template.doc: an unordered list row (a drawn accent dot hanging beside the text)
Template.use: with prose-list; not a run of these under every heading is the monotony rhythm.py exists to catch

Template.name: num-row
Template.doc: an ordered list row that carries weight (a filled accent circle carrying the number)
Template.use: with prose-list; not prose-item for a quiet 「1.」; step-row when each step has an owner or a criterion

Template.name: meta
Template.doc: one label/value row of the running head's right box (a 52px label column)
Template.use: with runhead

Template.name: bar
Template.doc: the head of a region that cites something other than requirements (a part-coloured block + a 200px neutral stub)
Template.use: with section-bar; not bar-req when the stub carries requirement ids

Template.name: bar-req
Template.doc: the head of a region that cites requirement ids (part-coloured block + ids in the stub)
Template.use: with section-bar-req; not the ids need no badge - the stub bounds them

Template.name: bar-req-key
Template.doc: the head of a region that cites a key phrase over its ids (part-coloured block + a two-line 264px stub)
Template.use: with section-bar-req-key; not both stub lines must stand on one line each inside 32px

Template.name: bar-ink
Template.doc: the inverse region head, at most one per page (an ink block + neutral stub)
Template.use: with section-bar; not a page that already carries ink-band, fact-band or anchor-row has spent its dark surface

Template.name: bar-quiet
Template.doc: a region head that opens with a rule instead of a fill (h2 + a 2px ink rule under it)
Template.use: not a page whose head names requirement ids must use section-bar-req*

Template.name: section-bar
Template.doc: a region opened by a title bar (bar + a 13px-gap slot)
Template.use: with bar

Template.name: section-bar-req
Template.doc: a region whose bar carries requirement ids (bar-req + slot)
Template.use: with bar-req

Template.name: section-bar-req-key
Template.doc: a region whose bar carries a key phrase and its ids (bar-req-key + slot)
Template.use: with bar-req-key

Template.name: section
Template.doc: a heading and its body, with the gap above set once (icon heading + a 10px-gap slot)
Template.use: with any body shape; not section-req on a page whose head names requirement ids

Template.name: h2
Template.doc: a sub-section heading inside a region (13px accent icon + 12.5px ink)
Template.use: with section; not one bar per region, headings beneath it

Template.name: section-req
Template.doc: a heading that answers named requirement ids (icon heading + id badge + slot)
Template.use: with any body shape; not the badge's ids must be a subset of the page's reqs

Template.name: h2-req
Template.doc: a sub-section heading carrying requirement ids (icon + heading + id badge)
Template.use: with section-req

Template.name: reqbadge
Template.doc: a requirement number standing in the page body (a bordered chip on the lightest accent tint)
Template.use: with h2-req · card heads; not bare text under a heading reads as a stray fragment

Template.name: stat
Template.doc: one measured figure with its label and source (value + label + source, no stub)
Template.use: not superseded by stat-cell, whose accent stub tells two figures apart

Template.name: item
Template.doc: a heading and the paragraph that belongs to it, unboxed (icon head + a rule dropping to the body)
Template.use: with page · cols2; not detail-card when the item needs an edge of its own

Template.name: keyrow
Template.doc: a quiet label/value list (a 92px bold label + value)
Template.use: with section* · card; not pair-card when each row needs a head of its own

Template.name: quote
Template.doc: a passage quoted from a source, with the source under it (a serif quotation and a caption)
Template.use: with section*; not note for a citation; this one is for words the deck did not write

Template.name: note
Template.doc: an aside a region needs, opened by a bold mark (a footnote line with a bold lead)
Template.use: with section* · page; not ruled-note when the aside is a labelled statement, not a footnote

Template.name: req-cell
Template.doc: one requirement category: its count and where it is answered (label + 17px count + chapter reference at cellW)
Template.use: with cols3 · toc

Template.name: flow-step
Template.doc: one step of an unboxed process strip (head + note at stepW)
Template.use: with stage-strip · flow-arrow; not num-step when the steps carry a decision each

Template.name: flow-arrow
Template.doc: the connector between two flow-steps (a muted chevron)
Template.use: with flow-step

Template.name: num-step
Template.doc: one step of a process strip that carries a decision (round accent plate + head + note, bordered)
Template.use: with stage-strip; not flow-step when the strip should read unboxed

Template.name: stat-cell
Template.doc: a measured figure with its unit, label and source (a 2px accent stub + 24px value + unit)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3 · cols-rail; not fact-band when three figures belong to one claim

Template.name: lane
Template.doc: one subsystem layer: what it is, what it does, and what it leaves (numbered colour plate + tinted head + display verb + foot note)
Template.use: with page · cols2; not a layered table with lane cells when the layers are rows of one table

Template.name: ink-band
Template.doc: a claim the page turns on, set against the reading (ink band, kicker/head at the left, one running line)
Template.use: with page; not one dark surface per page

Template.name: index-rail
Template.doc: a typographic index standing beside the body it opens (kicker + two display lines + accent rule + slot)
Template.use: with cols-rail (rail slot); not copy-rail when the rail is a subject rather than an index

Template.name: ruled-note
Template.doc: an indexed note closed off from what follows (a 76px accent plate + body + hairline)
Template.use: with section*; not note for a footnote; delta-row when the label is a term

Template.name: proof-strip
Template.doc: a claim, its evidence number, and what closes it (bordered strip, head + proof badge, accent tail)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3; not proof-line when the claim needs no evidence number

Template.name: asset-card
Template.doc: a claim, its form, its evidence and a tinted foot (proof-strip + a form chip and a footer band)
Template.use: not superseded by proof-strip - two evidence cards were one too many

Template.name: delta-row
Template.doc: a term and what it means, read across (an accent label plate + a tinted body cell)
Template.use: with section*; not ruled-note when the label is a citation rather than a term

Template.name: brief-band
Template.doc: two prose panels and a dark stat panel (two tinted panels + an ink panel)
Template.use: not superseded by fact-band - the same band with readings instead of prose

Template.name: node-card
Template.doc: one node of a structure, with the role it plays (bordered card, icon head, role at the right)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3; not detail-card when the item has no role to name

Template.name: icon-band
Template.doc: a term and its statement, read across on a tint (icon + fixed-width head + body on a tint pair)
Template.use: with page; not delta-row for the accent pair; this one takes the subsystem code's colours

Template.name: num-card
Template.doc: a numbered item whose body is one paragraph (tinted card, 20px square accent plate)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3; not num-step when the item is a step in a strip

Template.name: transform-lane
Template.doc: input → operation → output (tinted in-panel + ink operation + accent out-panel)
Template.use: with page; not stage-strip when the stages are more than three

Template.name: fact-band
Template.doc: one measured figure and the three readings beside it (ink stat panel + three label/head/note columns)
Template.use: with page; not brief-band is superseded; stat-cell for a single figure

Template.name: anchor-row
Template.doc: one fixed figure and what it anchors, across the block (ink row, 105px label/value + head/subText)
Template.use: with page; not anchor-cell in a rail or a narrow column

Template.name: anchor-cell
Template.doc: one fixed figure and what it anchors, in a narrow column (ink cell, label over value over head/subText)
Template.use: with cols-rail · cols3; not anchor-row across the text block - its 105px label column leaves a rail no room

Template.name: decision-card
Template.doc: a value settled later, and what happens after the decision (tinted card, accent label, ink tail)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3; not choice-card when alternatives are on the table

Template.name: trigger-card
Template.doc: a trigger and the response to it, judged (tinted card, key badge, block label then pass label)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols2; not the two labels must be a block word and a pass word - a neutral pair takes card-key

Template.name: badge-panel
Template.doc: a panel opened by a badge chip, holding rows the page stacks (bordered panel, accent badge + right key)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols2; not needs a row parent - flexGrow resolves to zero height without one

Template.name: proof-line
Template.doc: a claim and its closing line, unboxed (head + footnote body + accent tail)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3; not proof-strip when there is an evidence number to cite

Template.name: verdict-row
Template.doc: a numbered commitment read as pass and block (round plate + head cell + pass panel + block panel)
Template.use: with section*; not ledger-row when neither panel is a judgement

Template.name: marker-band
Template.doc: the identity of a detail page, pinned at its start (ink band, 58px number plate + head/subText + tinted key cell)
Template.use: with page; not section-bar-req-key when the region is a heading rather than an identity

Template.name: detail-card
Template.doc: one item, an icon earning its place (tinted card, icon head, one paragraph)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3; not item when the block should read unboxed

Template.name: ladder-step
Template.doc: one rung of a ladder, each rung judged (number plate + head cell + pass panel + block panel)
Template.use: with section*; not step-row when the rung carries one closing attribute instead

Template.name: key-panel
Template.doc: a panel opened by a large accent key, holding rows the page stacks (tinted panel, 12.5px accent head + right key)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols2; not as badge-panel - needs a row parent

Template.name: paired-note
Template.doc: a heading and its subline facing two consequence lines (a labelW column + two lines, the second accent)
Template.use: with cols-rail · cols2; not keyrow when the right side is one plain value

Template.name: pair-card
Template.doc: two labelled rows under one head (tinted card, accent label then muted)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3; not the lightest of the labelled-row cards - no badge, no key

Template.name: step-row
Template.doc: an ordered step with a description and one closing attribute (accent number plate + tinted step name + body + key cell)
Template.use: with section*; not num-row when the step is one line and carries nothing else

Template.name: trio-card
Template.doc: three labelled rows, the reading closing on the third (tinted card, accent · muted · ink labels)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3; not pair-card when the third row is not a conclusion

Template.name: axis-card
Template.doc: a numbered item with a reference key and two labelled rows (tinted card, 24px round plate, wide badge)
Template.use: with cols2; not card-key when the item carries no number

Template.name: choice-card
Template.doc: a choice among alternatives, with what settles it (bordered card, key chip, two rows, accent tail)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3; not decision-card when the value is settled later rather than chosen now

Template.name: stage
Template.doc: a stage with a time on it (icon head + when + a 2px accent rule + body)
Template.use: with cols2 · section*; not stage-detail when the stage opens a block rather than standing alone

Template.name: ledger-row
Template.doc: a requirement and how it is met (a 240px demand column + arrow + answer)
Template.use: with section*; not card-split when the pair needs an edge and a key

Template.name: card
Template.doc: a discrete item whose body the page composes (bordered card, icon title bar, free slot)
Template.use: with cols2 · cols3; not detail-card when the body is one paragraph

Template.name: card-key
Template.doc: a discrete item whose title bar carries a key (card + a muted key at the bar's right)
Template.use: with cols2

Template.name: card-ink
Template.doc: the inverse card, at most one per page (card on an ink title bar)
Template.use: with cols2; not as bar-ink - one dark surface per page

Template.name: card-split
Template.doc: a demand facing the answer to it (card + two half-width labelled columns)
Template.use: with page · cols2; not ledger-row when the pair is one line each and repeats down the page
